meta.name: Venugopal V — portfolio tokens
meta.themeModel: light-first with a dark theme (the reference site has no dark mode — this is a deliberate extra)
meta.accentPolicy: exactly one accent (--primary) on CTAs, focus, active nav and one hero detail (.accent-dot)
meta.typography: Plus Jakarta Sans (UI/body) + JetBrains Mono (labels, captions)
meta.shape: one card radius (20px) + pills; 1px hairlines; warm layered shadows

evidenceLegend.REPO: value already present in this repository (globals.css / package.json / data.ts)
evidenceLegend.DERIVED: calculated for this blueprint from repo values plus the teardown measurements
evidenceLegend.INTENTIONAL-DIFF: differs from the MetaMask reference on purpose

bg.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: careful for the reference's pure #ffffff

primary.role: the single accent: CTAs, focus ring, active nav, .accent, .accent-dot
primary.risk: sits in the same orange family as the reference brand mark — shift hue/lightness if more distance is wanted

pastels.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: same technique as the reference's pastel tile grounds, own hues; mapped through Tailwind @theme so they are real utilities

navy.role: the one loud ground (Experience current role + Contact band)
navy.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: own navy instead of the reference's #190066

mono.use: mono-label captions, stat derivation notes, stack chips, 3D labels

h1.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: capped below the reference's 120px hero so a four-word name never eats the fold

body.value: 16px (browser default rem base), lead paragraphs 18px, line-height 1.6
body.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: the reference runs a 24px desktop body base

accentWord.note: reproduces the reference's one-emphasised-word gesture with a static webfont

accentDot.note: own signature; the reference uses a variable-font axis instead

wrap.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: narrower than the reference's 1920px container; satisfies the archive's >=24px mobile padding rule

sectionRhythm.note: P0 fix — the archive's measured median section step is 96px and under ~64px two sections read as one block

grid.value: 12-column Tailwind grid via gap utilities; capability block 2×2 (md:grid-cols-2), projects 2-up with one full-width card, proof strip 4-up desktop / 2-up tablet / 1-up mobile

heroFold.value: min-height 100svh with content centred; nav + eyebrow + h1 + supporting line + 2 CTAs + medallion must fit at 1280×800 and 390×844

radiusCard.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: the reference uses 40px bento tiles + 12px blocks; one radius keeps the system legible at portfolio scale

shadows.note: INTENTIONAL-DIFF: warm-neutral layered lifts instead of the reference's 0 24px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.1)

reveal.value: 500ms opacity + translateY(14px→0), stagger 90ms, gated behind html.enhanced (no-JS shows everything)

marquee.value: 40s linear loop, pause on hover, static on reduced motion

dropdown.value: 150ms opacity + translateY(-8px→0) (no close delay, unlike the reference's 1s)

medallion.value: spring-rotated toward the pointer, ≤18deg, returns to a calm 3/4 pose

motionDial.value: planned --motion: 1 / 0 multiplier covering every duration above

reducedMotion.value: no transforms, no masks, no count-ups, no marquee, no 3D tracking, native scroll; content always visible

smoothScroll.value: Lenis 1.3.26, fine pointers only, scroll-margin/scrollTo offset -80px

canvas.value: one shared lazy <Canvas> (ssr:false) with drei <View> per slot; z-index 30; pointer-events none

tiers.value: high/medium/low from src/lib/quality.ts; max active views 1 (low) / 2 (medium); DPR + shadow + material swap per tier

slots.concept: cursor-following photo medallion (portrait cutout + rim chit)
slots.fallback: framed portrait + 5 hero chips (heroChips); monogram badge when hasPhoto is false

slots.concept: role stage with three calm plates, no beacon
draggable keycap cloud mirroring the filter chips
one procedural mini-object per project (no logos or third-party marks)
small matte ring echoing the medallion

value: all 3D off under prefers-reduced-motion or Save-Data

contentSource.value: src/content/data.ts only — the DOM, JSON-LD and metadata all read from it

noFabrication.value: no phone number while showPhone:false; no invented metrics, dates, awards or testimonials; null dates render nothing

claimHonesty.value: every derived stat carries a mono-label caption stating its derivation; qualified claims never appear without a visible qualifier
